channel.title: India TV – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from India TV – Bias and Credibility (indiatvnews.com)

item.title: Kamal Haasan says his party MNM will not contest Tamil Nadu election, announces support to DMK
item.description: Haasan, who currently serves as a Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha, entered the Upper House unopposed on June 12 with the backing of the DMK alliance. His growing alignment with the ruling party has been evident over recent years.

item.title: US B-52 Stratofortress bomber issues distress call over UK airspace: Was an Iranian missile the reason?
item.description: A B-52H Stratofortress made a mid-air distress call over the United Kingdom and returned safely to RAF Fairford, with the cause still unknown.

item.title: If MS Dhoni plays as an Impact Player in IPL 2026, it
item.description: Aakash Chopra feels MS Dhoni should retire if he plays as an Impact Player in IPL 2026, stressing his value lies on the field. With CSK backing youth and Sanju Samson as a successor, signs point to a potential final season for the veteran.

item.title: Mangal-Budh Yuti 2026: Mars-Mercury conjunction in Pisces to boost career and money for these 3 zodiac signs
item.description: Mars and Mercury will form a conjunction in Pisces in April 2026, a phase linked with sharper thinking and action. This alignment may bring positive changes in career and finances for some zodiac signs, including Taurus, Gemini and Sagittarius.

item.title: 'Will Paralyse and drown you in the Gulf': Iran's top military adviser issues stark warning to US
item.description: Mohsen Rezaei, Iran's new military adviser and former IRGC commander, issued a stark warning to the United States, saying Iran could “paralyse” Washington and “sink” its ships in the Arabian Gulf if attacked.

item.title: KKR endure worst start to IPL campaign in 14 years after loss to Sunrisers Hyderabad by 65 runs
item.description: Kolkata Knight Riders went down to Sunrisers Hyderabad by 65 runs in the sixth of IPL 2026 at the Eden Gardens in Kolkata. This was their second game of the season and they have now lost both their matches so far and are rooted to ninth place in the points table.

item.title: Ranbir Kapoor
item.description: Ranbir Kapoor is not merely a fine actor but has also evolved into a bona fide superstar. Ramayana could prove to be the biggest and most significant film of his career. However, before that know about Ranbir Kapoor's cinematic journey.

item.title: Congress
item.description: Assembly elections will be held in Kerala in a single phase on April 9. The counting of votes will take place on May 4.

item.title: NCERT gets deemed university status; can offer programmes, sets up campuses
item.description: Now, NCERT can offer new courses/ programmes and sets up 'off-campus and offshore centres' in accordance with UGC guidelines.

item.title: Congress suffers setback in MP as Datia MLA Rajendra Bharti loses membership after conviction
item.description: A Delhi court on Thursday sentenced Madhya Pradesh Congress MLA Rajendra Bharti to three years' imprisonment in a cheating case involving the forging of bank records to obtain illegal interest payments between 1998 and 2011.

item.title: HAL imposes penalties on GE Aerospace over delayed Tejas fighter jet engines
item.description: HAL Chairman and Managing Director, DK Sunil, confirmed the action, stating that the delays have impacted the Tejas Mark 1A delivery schedule for the Indian Air Force (IAF).

item.title: Artemis II heads to Moon: NASA astronauts break free from Earth orbit after 50 years
item.description: Astronauts aboard Artemis II have successfully fired the engines to leave Earth's orbit and head toward the Moon, marking humanity's first crewed lunar journey since Apollo 17 in 1972. The mission is a major step toward future lunar landings and long-term space exploration.

item.title: 'Silenced, not defeated': Raghav Chadha's message to AAP after removal as Rajya Sabha deputy leader
item.description: Raghav Chadha has been with the AAP since its inception in 2012 and was considered close to Kejriwal. Moreover, he also served as the party's national treasurer and was a member of its Political Affairs Committee, the highest decision-making body.

item.title: Iran releases
item.description: Iran has released a list of eight major Middle Eastern bridges as potential targets in retaliation for a US-Israeli strike that partially destroyed its B1 bridge near Karaj. The strike killed eight and injured 95.

item.title: India
item.description: INS Aridhaman has completed its final sea tests and will soon become part of the Strategic Forces Command. This submarine comes after INS Arihant, which joined in 2016, and INS Arighaat, commissioned in August 2024.
